decisions.reason: The reference-class electrometer is central to the firm's decades of dosimetry and calibration knowledge, so the firm can interpret market feedback and refine it with ease, and as a flagship it remains secure.

The oncology risk management software builds on the firm's QA software and integration capabilities and supports its strategy of converging machine and patient QA, so clinical physicists can absorb user feedback to improve it.
The CT image quality phantom draws directly on the firm's measurement and imaging QA expertise and fits the flagship imaging QA line, so the firm can learn from early results and develop it further.

Although mammography is further from the firm's radiotherapy dosimetry core, the firm's physicists and its expanding imaging QA focus give it enough related knowledge to assimilate feedback, so it keeps the product while watching its performance.

The full-field mammography phantom is distant from the core and partly overlaps the other mammography phantom, but it complements the imaging QA push and benefits from shared phantom know-how, so it is kept for now.
The imaging QA instrument line is a strategic flagship that builds on the firm's measurement and integration capabilities, so it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
